title: MAWAM: Joint Imagination for Collaborative Robot Manipulation with a Multi-Agent World Action Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.29501v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World action models (WAMs) excel at robot manipulation by imagining future observations and decoding actions from them, yet remain confined to a single embodied agent. In practice, manipulation often requires multiple robots to collaborate across disjoint workspaces, coupled timing, and heterogeneous embodiments. Such coordination demands both spatiotemporal alignment of future interactions and awareness of individual embodiment and role identities, whereas existing decentralized per-robot policies, flat centralized models, and multi-robot VLAs fail to unite both. To bridge this gap, we present MAWAM, a multi-agent world action model that jointly predicts the future observations of multiple embodiments and decodes each agent's actions from them for collaborative manipulation. translated_title: MAWAM：基于多智能体世界动作模型的协作机器人操作联合想象
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型通过想象未来观测并从中解码动作，在机器人操作任务中表现出色，但仍局限于单个具身智能体。在实际应用中，操作任务往往需要多个机器人在不相交的工作空间、耦合的时间安排以及异构的实体形态之间进行协作。这种协调既需要对未来交互进行时空对齐，又需要感知各个智能体自身的实体形态和角色身份，而现有的去中心化单机器人策略、扁平化集中式模型以及多机器人视觉语言动作模型都无法将两者统一起来。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了MAWAM——一个多智能体世界动作模型，它联合预测多个实体的未来观测，并从中解码每个智能体的动作，以实现协作操作。通过智能体轴课程学习机制，MAWAM沿智能体维度对单智能体世界动作模型进行扩展，在共享权重下协调机器人团队。（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了MAWAM多智能体世界动作模型，通过联合想象多个具身智能体的未来观测并从中解码各自动作，实现了跨不相交工作空间、异构实体机器人团队的协作操作。
en_tdlr: Proposes MAWAM, a multi-agent world action model that jointly imagines future observations across multiple embodiments and decodes each agent's actions from them, enabling collaborative robot manipulation across disjoint workspaces and heterogeneous robot teams.
